mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 62 degrees under clear skies at Verona City Hall. We are currently under a moderate air quality alert with an index of 56, and while the waxing gibbous moon is visible, there are no ISS flyovers for us to track tonight.

City Hall has announced that the I Voted sticker contest is officially underway for students in grades K-12. Participants can submit their original, non-AI artwork until July 22, and the community will be invited to cast their votes for the winners between July 28 and August 7.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today features the Dane County Farmers Market, as well as live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, mark your calendars for yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27 and trivia nights starting July 28.
In our weekly police update, officers reported a notable incident on July 13, where a 36-year-old man was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle became disabled on a rock.
You are going to love the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor of the day. Since the shop is currently closed, set your alarms for their 10 AM opening to make sure you get a taste.
